excluded_from_project_license.reason: User-provided and/or third-party provenance and research material; original rights remain with applicable rights holders.
Decks, documents, data, images and other user inputs retain their existing rights/confidentiality.
Python and Node dependencies retain their own licenses and are not relicensed by Apache-2.0.
Trademark/copyright/license permissions must be established independently.
Rights and permitted use depend on provider terms and the rights in source inputs/assets.

asset_policy.rule: Only assets with an explicit Asset Manifest use decision that permits redistribution may enter a public delivery or packaged asset set. Reference-only and do-not-use assets remain excluded.

font_policy.rule: Slidethus may resolve/use host fonts locally but does not redistribute font files by default. Redistribution requires an explicit font license review.

model_policy.rule: Production model/provider implementations and generated outputs are governed by provider terms and source rights; Slidethus does not bundle production model weights.

prepared_environment_policy.rule: Any redistributed environment/container/prepared renderer cache that vendors third-party dependency files must include exact dependency license notices and an artifact-specific SBOM.
